principles: Relationship status requires explicit dialogue/canon or an appropriately limited descriptive label, not a physical-action count.
Direct contact, visual event, internal thought, reported occurrence, and future hypothesis have independent provenance.
Daily-life setups can be considered as hypothetical narrative possibilities; they are not instructions or predictions of specific sexual acts.
Confidence is scope-limited, not a numerical probability of future acts.
Existing E64/E65/E66-E68 action files are preserved without condensation.
